---
title: "Automate Tasks with GitHub Actions"
---

This website provides instructional materials for understanding and implementing GitHub Actions workflows to automate tasks in the cloud across different programming languages. [**The recording of this workshop can be found [here](https://youtu.be/WMwLGE_DxC0) on YouTube.**]{style="color: #e95420;"}

![](GitHub%20Actions%20diagram.png)

This workshop assumes (at minimum):

1.  you have basic coding experience (regardless of programming language)
2.  you have already created a GitHub account
3.  you have basic experience using Git and GitHub for version control

For more information on using Git and GitHub (particularly for R users), I recommend the [Happy Git and GitHub for the useR](https://happygitwithr.com) e-book created by Jenny Bryan. While there are R-specific suggestions for using Git from RStudio, much of the material is agnostic of programming language. Additionally, you may refer to this recording of a [Git and GitHub with RStudio workshop](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6TTo6CAx7mk) I led in 2022.

Please submit any questions on the [Discussions](https://github.com/joshcullen/github_actions_workshop/discussions) page of the GitHub repo hosting this website and associated materials, which may serve as a forum to ask questions not covered in these materials.
